name: foodflow-monorepo
description: FoodFlow - Distributed Food Delivery System Design Simulator

scripts.dev:restaurant-1: cross-env PORT=4001 INSTANCE_ID=restaurant-service-1 npm run dev --workspace=@foodflow/restaurant-service
scripts.dev:restaurant-2: cross-env PORT=4002 INSTANCE_ID=restaurant-service-2 npm run dev --workspace=@foodflow/restaurant-service
scripts.dev:order-1: cross-env PORT=4004 INSTANCE_ID=order-service-1 npm run dev --workspace=@foodflow/order-service
scripts.dev:order-2: cross-env PORT=4005 INSTANCE_ID=order-service-2 npm run dev --workspace=@foodflow/order-service
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "GATEWAY,REST-1,REST-2,USER,ORD-1,ORD-2,PAY-WRK,KITCH-WRK,DELIV-WRK,CTRL,WEB" -c "cyan,blue,blue,green,magenta,magenta,yellow,orange,purple,red,emerald" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:restaurant-1" "npm run dev:restaurant-2" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:order-1" "npm run dev:order-2" "npm run dev:worker-payment" "npm run dev:worker-kitchen" "npm run dev:worker-delivery" "npm run dev:control" "npm run dev:web"
